pages.title: Load and Light
pages.text: Use a heatable workpiece and solid furnace fuel, then ignite with Flint and Steel, Fire Starter, Fire Charge, or a supported igniter. Fuel loading alone never lights it. Burning fuel can catch queued fuel; after complete burnout it must be lit again.

pages.title: Carry the Heat
pages.text: One item takes about five seconds from cold to full heat; larger stacks heat more slowly. Burning fuel maintains heat. Empty-hand use retrieves the workpiece for the anvil. Heat belongs to the item, not just the station.

pages.title: Not a Furnace
pages.text: The kiln never smelts, fires pottery, or advances forge actions. It accepts forge ingredients and tagged heatable items. Glow and light show hot work. Reheating an unfinished forging batch preserves its completed actions.
